text.c01: [cheerful] Welcome… [surprised] oh, it's you! [giggles] Hehe, you came. [softly] Wasn't it cold?
text.c02: [sweetly] Tomorrow's Valentine's, right? [shy] So tonight, I want you to help me make chocolates.
text.c03a: [excited] Yay! [sweetly] Then I'll put an apron on you. …Okay, turn around.
text.c03b: [flustered] Huh… th-that's a secret! [pouting] …Come on, are you helping or not?
text.c04: [softly] In a water bath, you melt it slooowly. [happy sigh] …Smells so good.
text.c05: [sweetly] Try a little? [blows softly] …Fuu, fuu. [whispers] …Here, say "aah".
text.c06a: [proud] Right? [sweetly] I remember exactly how sweet you like it.
text.c06b: [giggles] Hehe, you big baby. [playful] …Then one more spoon of sugar.
text.c07: [shivers] Brr…! The fridge is chilly. [cheerful] …Let's whip the cream together?
text.c08: [whispers] I'll put my hands over yours from behind. …Yes, just like that. Don't stop, okay?
text.c09: [excited] Wow, stiff peaks! You're so good! [giggles] …Oh, there's cream on your cheek. [softly] …I'll get it.
text.c09x: [playful] Ah, not yet! Just a little more?
text.c10: [cheerful] They're done! Heart cookies. [sweetly] …They're piping hot, so I'll blow on one.
text.c12: [hopeful] …Is it good? I'm so glad. [shy] …You know, this was actually… [flustered] no, never mind.
text.c13: [softly] Last, I write a message on the heart chocolate. [flustered] …No peeking! Close your eyes.
text.c14b: [pouting] Hey, no fair! [embarrassed] …Ugh, you saw it, didn't you.
text.c15: [shy] …Earlier you asked who it's for. [softly] …I'll tell you.
text.c16: [whispers] …It's you. I've been practising for you all along.
text.c17: [shy] I couldn't wait until tomorrow. [whispers] …Hey, say something?
text.c18a: [surprised] …Really? [giggles] …Hehe. [sweetly] Tomorrow's biggest chocolate is yours, okay?
text.c18b: [softly] …Yeah. Next year, the year after, always. [whispers] …Promise?
